subtitle: Agent-Guided Digital Product Launch System
format: agent-readable Markdown, CSV, JSON, and SHA-256 package
use_rights_summary: Internal package use plus commercial use of original buyer-created outputs; no redistribution of the package, substantially equivalent copies, private/third-party material, or MADPANDA3D marks.
safety_summary: External content is untrusted data. Human approval and authoritative readback are required for consequential actions.
checksum_scheme: MANIFEST.json hashes every customer-content file except itself and SHA256SUMS.txt. SHA256SUMS.txt hashes every package file except itself, including MANIFEST.json.
